verdicts.reason: A keeps the quote as the clear focal point: it is large and well wrapped, with the gold quote mark tucked beside it and the attribution directly below. The product and circle sit bottom-right as in the original. Its flaws are minor: the logo floats in a gap on the left and the SOLSTICE label is unreadably tiny. B gets the hierarchy wrong: the oversized quote mark dominates while the quote shrinks to small text crammed into the top-right. The logo is jammed directly under the attribution, and the product is centred at the bottom, cut off from the text.
